content.AGENTS.md:
## Testing and verification

- Verify the narrowest relevant behavior first, then broaden when shared code, schemas, build configuration, routing, or release behavior changes.
- Test observable behavior and meaningful failure paths; avoid tests coupled to private implementation details.
- Do not hide failing checks or weaken tests to make a change pass.
- Report exact commands run, outcomes, and any verification gaps.
